viralPosts.author: knighthawk899.bsky.social

viralPosts.text:
Just learned 'access fatigue' 🤯

meaning: the effects of constantly having to explain, teach, & reinvent access. This demand wears us down, shapes how we see ourselves, and makes pushing for inclusion harder. 

It IS exhausting. I'm so glad I have the vocabulary for this now.

#DisabilityJustice
viralPosts.author: ellatholmes.bsky.social

viralPosts.text:
My favourite wheels are still our e-tandem. It brings joy - never mind ease and predictability - to the coldest, windiest and wettest of trips. I want everyone to have the option of using mobility aids they can enjoy as much as we enjoy ours!
#ActiveTravel #Accessibility
viralPosts.author: tandemkate.bsky.social

viralPosts.text:
An icon button with a visible label doesn't need an aria-label on the icon. The icon should be treated as a decorative image using aria-hidden.

Both the aria-label on the icon and the visible lable would both be announced which is redundant and possibly confusing.

#A11y #FrontEnd
viralPosts.author: xirclebox.com

viralPosts.text:
A large amount of sign ups for the jam come from it being highly rated on Itch, so even if you're unsure if you can join, feel free to press join! You can leave later, but clicking join will make sure you don't miss it starting, and promote it!
#Gamedev #A11y
